_help: The journal's Places pages (scripts/sites/journal_screen.gd). Keys are the journal's place names (the clues' "place"), so a page counts the clues found there. A page shows once its "if" passes (Game.check; "act": N = Act N reached) or a clue was found there. "route": a route board id: the page says which way you went. Notes as in people.json. Edit freely.

Cairo.name: Cairo
Cairo.text: The docks, the bazaar, the museum and the hotels. Where the bad day began, and where the expedition was raised, one day and three errands at a time.

notes.text: Back again, with the thieves in its streets and the dead not far behind.

The road to Akmentar.name: The road to Akmentar
The road to Akmentar.text: A race: the first expedition to reach Akmentar has the first pick of the ruins, and the Americans and the Germans are on the same roads.

Akmentar, the surface.name: Akmentar, the surface
Akmentar, the surface.text: Twelve places worth digging, shared out between three expeditions. Whoever arrived first chose first.

Akmentar, the second level.name: Akmentar, the second level
Akmentar, the second level.text: The chambers under the surface, where what was learned above decides how safely the burial chamber can be opened.

Akmentar, the royal tomb.name: Akmentar, the royal tomb
Akmentar, the royal tomb.text: The last door below Akmentar, and what lay behind it.

The road back to Cairo.name: The road back to Cairo
The road back to Cairo.text: Back across the desert to Cairo, with the thieves ahead and the dead behind, and every day counted.

The return to Akmentar.name: The return to Akmentar
The return to Akmentar.text: The jars and the amulet have to go back where they came from, and the mummy follows wherever they go.

Akmentar, the last descent.name: Akmentar, the last descent
Akmentar, the last descent.text: The places dug in the first days, now held by the mummy's servants, and the altar at the bottom of it all.
